$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (ori-public-serving, REQ-EP-010). Adds fixedFilters to endpoint: the fields a single object fetched by id must carry for the endpoint to answer it. An object that fails them answers the same 404 as a missing one (EndpointIdFetchGuard). Optional; an endpoint without it behaves as before.

fixedFilters.title: Fixed filters
fixedFilters.description: Fields an object must carry to be answered by id, for example lifecycle published. An object that does not match answers not found. Give one value, or a list of which any one passes.
